description: Marks the active plan completed, blocked, or cancelled. When working in the current conversation, omit conversationId; never pass placeholders such as `current`, `this`, or `active`. If you include conversationId, it must be the real UUID. This closes plan state only and does not alter other tool access. Call complete_plan with status="completed" only when the root objective is actually done. outcome.status is plan-item satisfaction, not an external backtest/deployment/trade status. A completed item with outcome.status="unsuccessful" or outcome.status="partial" is audit evidence for an attempt, not proof the root objective is done; add or update explicit follow-up work that references that item, or use blocked/cancelled for a real blocker. Do not tell the user the plan is done while the root plan is still active.

conversationId.description: Optional conversation UUID. Omit this field to use the current MCP conversation context; never pass placeholders such as `current`.

planId.description: Optional plan UUID. In the current conversation, omit planId unless you already have the actual plan id from get_active_plan or a wake message. Never pass a plan item id here; target plan items through target.itemId or target.position.

name: complete_plan
title: Complete plan
